whenToUse: The same structure repeats, as with products, plans, or articles.
Buttons at the bottom of cards should line up.
The column count changes with the width.
whenNotToUse: Card heights differ a lot (use masonry).
There are many values to compare (use a table).
There are only one or two cards.

alternatives.name: Card
alternatives.reason: How a single card is built.

accessibility: The card list is a named ul, so the number of items is read along with it.
Lay cards out as vertical flex and give the button mt-auto so the rows line up.
The column count follows the container width, and the DOM order is kept.
When buttons share a name, add the product with aria-label.
